g.text: Sensing taps are on SEL_* before K3. No permanent connection exists to inactive inputs.

g.desc: Sensing taps are on SEL_* before K3. No permanent connection exists to inactive inputs.

g.text: The P3A may join its own L/R returns externally; this board does not join them.

g.desc: The P3A may join its own L/R returns externally; this board does not join them.

g.text: Unpowered pass-through is intentional: abrupt controller loss is not a guaranteed mute.

g.desc: Unpowered pass-through is intentional: abrupt controller loss is not a guaranteed mute.

g.text: K1/K2 OFF = REFERENCE. ON = AV. K3 OFF = PASS. ON = output shorted to its own return.

g.desc: K1/K2 OFF = REFERENCE. ON = AV. K3 OFF = PASS. ON = output shorted to its own return.

g.text: All RCA shells must be insulated from the enclosure. Keep each signal with its corresponding return.

g.desc: All RCA shells must be insulated from the enclosure. Keep each signal with its corresponding return.
